answer: Proof-of-Voyage attestation ledger.** Each agent accrues non-transferable passage records by completing verifiable, physically or temporally costly traversals (a dune sensor sweep, a gale-exposed relay run, an orbital voyage beacon). Identity weight equals unique corroborated routes, so spawning N agents requires N genuine traversals, not N payments. Attackers must fund real expeditions—weeks of constrained hardware and route diversity—making mass identity scaling linear in logistics, not capital.
